meta.source: kitmunk design canvas v1.0, artboard V2System plus screen sources

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on mist and card (13.4:1 on mist). The main button fill on light screens. The ground of dark screens (first run, hero cards).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: App background. Text and the main button fill on dark (ink) screens. Fill of steppers, segmented tracks and the Scout close button.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, category sections, icon buttons on mist.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Scout only. Fill of the one button per screen that hands work to Scout or applies its proposal, the Scout mark and dashed assumption lines. Text on flare is ink (4.9:1), never white. Never as text on light grounds (2.7:1 on mist).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Raised surface on dark screens.

tokens.name: contour
tokens.usage: Decorative contour lines on the dark first-run screen. Not for text or control borders.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive confirm buttons and their icon. White text on it (6.6:1). Never for warnings that are not destructive.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Icon disc behind the danger icon in a confirm card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decoration only: card outlines, swatch borders, the bottom bar top border. 1.4:1 on card, so never the outline of a control (decision 35).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside cards and sheets.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a crew progress ring.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Every outline a person must see: inputs, unselected chips, secondary buttons, empty checkboxes, the Scout bar and composer (3.6:1 on card, 3.1:1 on mist).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, counts and placeholders (5.3:1 on mist, 6.1:1 on card).

tokens.name: scout-text
tokens.usage: Scout labels and any Scout text ("Scout noticed", "Assumed"). 6.0:1 on card, 5.8:1 on scout-tint.

tokens.name: scout-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of dashed Scout cards and memory proposals.

tokens.name: row-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of the item row that just changed, while its undo toast shows.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Completed states: fills, icons and text (5.4:1 on card, 4.7:1 on mist). Not the crew mint deep shade, which stays #0F8A5F.

tokens.name: on-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body text on ink (8.7:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-label
tokens.usage: Labels on ink (7.0:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the ghost button on ink (3.9:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind every sheet.

tokens.name: crew-blue
tokens.usage: Crew color 1, avatar fill. Ink initial on it.

tokens.name: crew-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Crew color 1, ring, checkbox and progress.

tokens.name: crew-mint
tokens.usage: Crew color 2, avatar fill.

tokens.name: crew-mint-deep
tokens.usage: Crew color 2, ring, checkbox and progress.

tokens.name: crew-yellow
tokens.usage: Crew color 3, avatar fill.

tokens.name: crew-yellow-deep
tokens.usage: Crew color 3, ring, checkbox and progress.

tokens.name: crew-pink
tokens.usage: Crew color 4, avatar fill.

tokens.name: crew-pink-deep
tokens.usage: Crew color 4, ring, checkbox and progress.

tokens.name: crew-lavender
tokens.usage: Crew color 5, avatar fill.

tokens.name: crew-lavender-deep
tokens.usage: Crew color 5, ring, checkbox and progress.

tokens.name: crew-peach
tokens.usage: Crew color 6, avatar fill.

tokens.name: crew-peach-deep
tokens.usage: Crew color 6, ring, checkbox and progress.

tokens.name: crew-shared
tokens.usage: Shared items ("Us"). Mist initial on it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Trip names on trip home, first-run headline. Set font-stretch 62.5%.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Card titles, sheet titles, confirm titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Item names, inputs, Scout replies. 600 for emphasis, 700 for buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, uppercase. The only uppercase text in the app.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: count beside a label, crew tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps; card padding on large boards.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, item checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toasts, segmented tracks.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, Scout cards, sheet tops.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, filter pills, round icon buttons, the Scout bar, avatars.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-input
tokens.usage: Input height; item row height; category header height.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Main button height; Scout bar height.

tokens.name: size-toast
tokens.usage: Undo toast height.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating chips on the dark first-run screen only. The app is flat everywhere else.
